description: An exhilarating 11-day adventure trip to New York City, packed with outdoor activities, unique experiences, and exploration of the city's vibrant culture. This itinerary balances thrilling adventures with opportunities to discover iconic landmarks and hidden gems.

What you'll see: Challenging obstacles and thrilling ziplines.

What to eat: Enjoy a casual meal at a nearby cafe after your adventure. 
Good to know: Safety equipment and instructions will be provided for this exciting experience.

days.title: Snorkelling Day Trip
days.description: Discover the underwater world with a snorkelling day trip from New York.

activities.activity_name: Snorkelling Day Trip from New York
activities.notes:
What you'll see: Marine life and coastal scenery during your snorkelling excursion. 
What to bring: Swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, and a change of clothes. 
What to eat: Lunch is often included or available for purchase on such trips. 
Good to know: This activity is suitable for families and adventure seekers looking for a refreshing experience.

days.title: New York Kayak & Coastline Tour

activities.address: Lower East Side, New York, United States
activities.notes:
What you'll see: The New York skyline and coastal areas from the water.

What to eat: Enjoy a meal at a waterfront restaurant after your kayaking adventure. 
Good to know: This tour is perfect for active travelers and offers a different view of the city.

days.title: Private Bike Tour & Cultural Exploration

activities.notes:
What you'll see: Key landmarks and hidden paths of New York with a personalized guide.

What to eat: Stop for a quick and authentic New York bagel or street food. 
Good to know: A private tour allows for a customized route and pace, perfect for exploring specific interests.

activities.activity_name: Historic New York City Walking Tour
activities.notes:
What you'll see: Historic neighborhoods, significant buildings, and cultural sites. 
What to bring: Comfortable walking shoes, water, and an inquisitive mind. 
What to eat: Explore local eateries in the historic district for dinner. 
Good to know: This tour provides insights into the rich history and diverse culture of New York City.

days.title: Countryside Day Trip
days.description: Take a break from the city bustle with a relaxing day trip to the New York countryside.

activities.notes:
What you'll see: Picturesque landscapes, charming towns, and natural beauty outside the city. 
What to bring: Comfortable clothing, a camera, and any personal snacks or drinks. 
What to eat: Enjoy a meal at a local restaurant in the countryside. 
Good to know: This day trip offers a refreshing change of scenery and a chance to relax.

days.title: Museums & Galleries

activities.activity_name: New York Museum & Gallery Pass — Small Group Edition
activities.notes:
What you'll see: World-class art collections and historical exhibits. 
What to bring: Comfortable shoes for walking and an open mind for learning.

Good to know: A small group edition allows for a more intimate and guided experience.
